title: The First Token Has a Different Job
description:
LLM inference has two different jobs: prefill reads the prompt in parallel, while decode generates one token at a time. This short shows how the KV cache avoids rereading history, FlashAttention reduces memory movement, speculative decoding drafts ahead, and batching plus load balancing keep shared hardware busy.

Part 7 of this LLM evolution series. Follow for Part 8: one missing token through the Transformer, end to end.

#LLM #AIInference #MachineLearning #Shorts
